sections.title: Attaching a whole sentence with hogy
sections.content: You know *hogy* ("that") from earlier: it lets you attach a whole sentence as the object of *remélem* ("I hope") or a *célom* *az*, *hogy*... ("my goal is that..."). Everything after *hogy* is a normal, independent sentence — nothing changes about how it conjugates.

items.spanish: Remélem, hogy jövőre folyékonyan beszélek magyarul.
items.english: I hope that next year I'll speak Hungarian fluently.

items.spanish: A célom az, hogy minden nap gyakoroljak egy kicsit.
items.english: My goal is to practise a little every day.

sections.content: *remélem* is the definite "I hope" form (from *remél*) — used here as a fixed opener, exactly like ismerem or tudom, followed by a comma and then *hogy* plus a full sentence. After *a célom az, hogy* the verb takes the *-jak/-jek* form you know from *Mit csináljak?* (*gyakoroljak*, *beszéljek*), because a goal is something you want, not a fact.
